message.content:
Here are a few popular sushi spots in Tokyo that you might want to try:

| Restaurant | Location | Highlights |
|------------|----------|-------------|
| **Sushi Saito** | Ginza | Michelin‑starred, intimate setting, top‑grade fish |
| **Sushi Yoshitake** | Ginza | 3 Michelin stars, meticulous preparation |
| **Sushi Jiro (Jiro Sushi)** | Roppongi | Famous from *Jiro Dreams of Sushi*, 3 Michelin stars |
| **Sushi Dai** | Tsukiji Outer Market | Legendary line‑up, fresh tuna |
| **Sushi Zanmai** | Multiple locations | 24/7 service, affordable, wide variety |
| **Sushi Kyubey** | Ginza | Classic ambiance, high quality nigiri |
| **Sushi Sawada** | Shinjuku | 2 Michelin stars, creative rolls |
| **Sushi Masuda** | Shibuya | Small, cozy, excellent omakase |
| **Sushi Noda** | Shibuya | 2 Michelin stars, seasonal tasting menu |
| **Sushi Tsubaki** | Shinjuku | 2 Michelin stars, refined omakase |

These places range from high‑end Michelin‑starred experiences to more casual, budget‑friendly options. If you’re planning a visit, it’s wise to make reservations well in advance—especially for the Michelin‑starred spots. Enjoy your sushi adventure!
